records.monitor_reason: County planners approved the Bauxite III site plan, but no generator or air permit application names it.

verifications.note: Report on county approval of Rowan Bauxite II and Bauxite III.

records.researcher_notes: A Data Center Dynamics report says the Frederick County planning commission approved Rowan's Bauxite II and Bauxite III projects at the Quantum campus. The only generator application I found is Amazon's for the IAD-534 campus, which a tracker links to Bauxite II. I found no generator count or application for Bauxite III, and no Public Service Commission exemption case for either. It becomes an add when a permit or application names generators.
